stage: Separate budget-sensitivity follow-up, motivated by truncation counts observed during primary inference; original comparison and gate follow-up remain unchanged

motivation.interpretation: Frequent forced closure limits conclusions about reasoning; test one predetermined larger reasoning budget, not a search over budgets.

case_selection: The first sixteen evaluation cases in the original frozen manifest order; four per original task family. All are reused primary tasks, with no selection by success, cue label, or acoustic quality.
control: Reuse the original reasoning-arm outputs on these exact sixteen tasks; do not rerun or replace them.

intervention.other_settings: Identical Qwen3-8B BF16 weights, prompts, tools, base seed and case/turn offsets, action cap 512, eight turns, sixteen tool calls, 16384 context tokens, and 600-second episode deadline. No configuration gate or reviewer.

primary_endpoint: Original strict task success; scorer unchanged
analysis: Paired recording-level differences on sixteen reused tasks, 10000 paired bootstrap resamples and exact McNemar test. Exploratory budget-sensitivity analysis, separate from the original three primary comparisons and separate from the sixteen-new-group configuration-gate experiment. Report all sixteen outcomes and actual cost.
scope: Tests a larger per-turn and total reasoning budget together; not a model, hardware, new-data, or general-reasoning superiority claim. Longer-budget jobs run after the primary and gate phases, so latency is descriptive for this sequential implementation.
preservation: One fixed larger-budget condition, no prompt feedback, no favorable reruns, no changes to original outputs or scoring.
stop_policy: Queue after the existing configuration-gate experiment; require at least three hours before the existing 19:09 UTC job deadline. Enforce the external timeout and retain partial/failure records if interrupted; leave the pod running.
